profile.headline: Software Engineer - Turning complex ideas into shipped product | IoT, Robotics, EdgeAI
profile.summary: Software Engineer with a product-focused approach, diverse background, and a proven track record of developing and scaling sophisticated systems, ranging from autonomous robotics and global IoT infrastructures to sensor-integrated Edge AI solutions.

positions.title: Co-Founder and CEO
positions.description: I co-founded Scanse  in response to the lack of affordable, time of flight, scanning LiDAR available on the market. Together we designed and built the product and initially launched it on Kickstarter. With the help of a great small team, we successfully delivered the product along with several supporting software applications. We continued to produce and distribute thousands more worldwide to retailers including Sparkfun and Robotshop, as well as develop additional software and hardware that greatly expanded the scanner’s capabilities.

positions.title: Co-founder
positions.description: I co-founded Uptronics in response to my interest in rapidly exploring different market verticals that required mechatronic type consulting. Over the course of three years, we completed twenty projects for companies small and large in which we produced software, electrical, and mechanical prototypes as well as finished products for markets ranging from fitness to solar.

positions.title: Robotics Engineer
positions.locationName: San Luis Obispo County, California, United States
positions.description: Developed localization and path planning software for mobile platforms to be used in U.S. Navy training.

educations.schoolName: California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo

projects.title: Sweep 3D Scanner
projects.description: I, along with two other teammates, designed and built one of the first sub $1000, 360x270 degree, survey LiDAR scanner. We open sourced the entire design and shipped several hundred kits worldwide.

projects.title: Sweep LiDAR Kickstarter
projects.description:
Sweep was one of, if not the first sub $1000, long range, time of flight, scanning LiDAR, that sold for $349. I Developed the product's electronics, embedded software, several supporting SDKs, and directed development of all other software.

Kickstarter raised $272,990.
Successfully delivered to all backers,.
Shipped thousands of units to more than 90 countries
